item.title: Ottawa man, 71, and Renfrew man, 55, in Hwy 17 collision
item.description: A pickup truck and another passenger vehicle crashed head-on Saturday afternoon in the Township of McNab-Braeside.

item.title: Linus Ullmark makes a heroic return to net as Ottawa Senators down the New Jersey Devils
item.description: It was the veteran goalie's first start since Dec. 27 and followed a lengthy break for mental health leave.

item.title: B.C. chef wins Canadian Culinary Championship for third straight year
item.description: The gold-winning dish leaned fully into chicken — skin, heart, liver and all — while Ottawa placed in the top three. Here's how they closed the gap on the podium.

item.title: Senators player grades: Ullmark unflappable, Sanderson Norris-like in win over Devils
item.description: Linus Ullmark was near perfect, Jake Sanderson had two assists in a two-way masterclass, Tim Stutzle was on fire offensively, and Artem Zub was steady as ever in the Ottawa Senators' third straight regulation win, 4-1 against the New Jersey Devils.

item.title: From fine dining to bedside trays: How Steven Beckta helps transform food at The Ottawa Hospital
item.description: For a hospital whose breakfast offering was once described as a "yellow puck of sadness," the food as medicine approach represents a radical change.

item.title: Police probe death of Bath Institution inmate
item.description: A 49-year-old inmate died Saturday after being found "in medical distress in his cell."

item.title: It's high time Senators defenceman Jake Sanderson entered Norris Trophy discussion
item.description: The Ottawa Senators defenceman, in his fourth NHL season, is putting on a nightly two-way clinic, and the team's recent success in its own end is largely thanks to him.

item.title: Gatineau police ask for help in search for missing 24-year-old
item.description: Nathaniel Boisseau was last seen early Sunday morning as he left his residence on Sacré-Coeur Boulevard, in the Hull sector, on foot

item.title: Redblacks raid roster of Cup-champion Roughriders as CFL's 'communication window' opens
item.description: According to 3DownNation, the Ottawa Redblacks have agreed to terms on a one-year contract with quarterback Jake Maier, who spent last season as a backup with the Saskatchewan Roughriders

item.title: Psychosis more common in recent generations in Ontario, study says
item.description: The findings, Ottawa researcher Dr. Daniel Myran says, raise important questions about the possible causes and consequences of increasing numbers of psychotic disorder diagnoses.
